claims.claim: The location control ends at x 233, left of the capsule (281) with a 48 px gap.
claims.evidence: list.png: the location text ends at about x 222 CSS (445 px ÷ 2), with its chevron just after. The capsule starts at about x 281, so the two don't overlap.

claims.claim: The capsule is drawn as a neutral light-scheme placeholder at left 281, top 50, 87 × 32.
claims.evidence: list.png, filter.png, empty.png: a white pill with ••• and ◎ spans about x 281–368 and y 50–82 CSS. Nothing overlaps it.

claims.claim: The filter panel drops down from the sort bar and ends above the native tab bar
claims.evidence: filter.png: the panel starts below the sort bar (y ≈ 229) and ends at about y 716. A thin grey dim strip follows, then the tab bar at about y 729. Location, search, categories and sort bar stay visible above the panel.

claims.claim: "不限" is the default. It shows as tinted but has no check badge, so the three badges match the "筛选 3" count.
claims.evidence: filter.png: check badges appear only on 今天, 1 km 内 and 可开发票. 不限 is teal-tinted with no badge. The sort bar shows 筛选 with a '3' badge.

claims.claim: The fifth tab (管道疏通) fades out at the right edge on purpose, as the scroll cue.
claims.evidence: list.png, filter.png, empty.png: the category row ends with '管道疏…', which fades out at the right edge.

claims.claim: No per-row "预约" button, to keep rows calm
claims.evidence: list.png: the rows show slot, title, provider, rating, tags, distance and price. None of them has a 预约 button.

claims.claim: It is teal when the slot is today and neutral for later days
claims.evidence: list.png: rows 1 and 4 (今天 16:00, 今天 18:30) have teal stubs. Rows 2 and 3 (明天 09:00, 明天 14:00) have neutral grey stubs.

claims.claim: Counts are shown exactly as the brief gives them (12,480 次), not rounded to 万
claims.evidence: list.png: '已服务 12,480 次', '3,216 次' and '1,905 次' match the brief.

claims.claim: The no-results suggestions are sorted by how many results they give: 明天 6, 3 km 内 4, 去掉可开发票 1.
claims.evidence: empty.png: the suggestion rows read 改成明天上门 6 个服务, 放宽到 3 km 内 4 个服务, 去掉「可开发票」1 个服务, in that order, each with a chevron.

claims.claim: In the filter panel the relaxation "去掉「可开发票」" is shortened to "不限发票" ... The no-results screen uses the full wording.
claims.evidence: filter.png: the hint line reads '不限发票 1 个'. empty.png: the row reads '去掉「可开发票」'.

claims.claim: Both buttons have the same secondary weight, because the suggestion rows are the main path.
claims.evidence: empty.png: 修改筛选 and 清除筛选 are two grey pills of the same size and style. Neither has the primary teal fill.

claims.claim: All text pairs pass AA. ... Targets are at least 44 px, including chips and inline links.
claims.evidence: facts.md: 0 text nodes below AA on any page (0/62, 0/54, 0/35). Targets under 44 px: 0 on all three pages.

notes: All 12 claims match the renders or facts.md. I found no contradictions. Caveat: facts.md only counts targets that are marked up as interactive, so the 44 px result is a lower bound. Claims about behaviour (tapping chips or suggestions, what 修改筛选 and 清除筛选 do) and the large-font variants that weren't drawn can't be checked from a static render, so I left them out.
